name: I wanna sleep with my teddy bear, but daddys hitting mommy again
source:
A romantic comedy set in a sci-fi alternate-history world where humanityfollowed the path of vapor energy.

Take on the role of Ferix Detto, a sixteen-year-old boy and aspiring vaper, and carve your way toward love in a world scarred by countless wars.

Perhaps you may even succeed in changing the tragic fate of this cursed world...
translation:
一部以科幻平行历史世界为背景的浪漫喜剧，人类沿着蒸汽能量的道路前进。

扮演费里克斯·德托 (Ferix Detto) 的角色，一名16岁男孩，一位有抱负的电子烟爱好者，在一个饱受战争创伤的世界中开拓自己的爱情之路。

也许你甚至可以成功改变这个被诅咒的世界的悲惨命运……
